segments.title: 第102章 好朋友
segments.content:
"Zhusheng, come to our place for dinner tonight."

Hugging the Pikachu plushie Yan Zhusheng had given her, Ying Chanxi proactively extended the invitation.

Yan Zhusheng naturally had no objection and nodded, taking out her phone to call the cooking auntie and tell her there was no need to cook tonight.

The three of them waited for Xu Youyu at the school gate, then returned to Bihai Lanting 1502 together.

Ying Chanxi returned to her bedroom and placed the Pikachu on her nightstand, just as she heard Li Luo ask from the doorway, "Where do these plushies go?"

"Wherever." Ying Chanxi waved her hand. "Just don't put them in my room."

Tsk, tsk.

Li Luo looked down at the plushies in his arms and shook his head, sighing on their behalf.

Even among plushies, the treatment was worlds apart.

"I don't know what you were thinking." Xu Youyu flopped onto the sofa as soon as she got home. Having already heard about Li Luo's glorious deeds on the way back, she dangled her feet and said with a smile, "You don't actually think Chanxi likes plushies, do you?"

"Doesn't she?" Li Luo was a little unconvinced. He placed the plushies in his hands on the windowsill, lining them up in a row.

"What girls like has always been the person who gives them the plushie," Xu Youyu said unhurriedly. "When it's someone they're close with, they'll like whatever they're given."

"And if it's someone they're not close with?"

"Well." Xu Youyu jutted her chin, pointing to the row of plushies in front of Li Luo. "Isn't their fate right before your eyes?"

"Then what do you like people to give you, Senior?"

"I'm about to run out of sanitary pads. You can get me some of those."

"You'd better buy that stuff yourself." Li Luo shook his head repeatedly. "Most guys can't even tell the brands apart, let alone the difference between daytime and nighttime use."

"You know about this?" Xu Youyu was a bit surprised.

"Ahem... I've learned a little bit about it."

Hearing him say that, Xu Youyu showed an expression of understanding.

He was an online novelist, after all. It was pretty normal for him to know a bit of this strange little knowledge that was unusual for guys.

Xu Youyu herself loved searching online for little tidbits about guys to better integrate a male perspective into her web novels.

After chatting for a while, Ying Chanxi called Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng downstairs to go grocery shopping.

Li Luo also went downstairs for a bit, heading to the bank to check his bank card balance.

A deposit of over ninety thousand yuan.

It was hard to imagine that this was money a high school student had earned in just three or four months without relying on his parents.

Li Luo recalled his own high school days in his past life. After deducting food expenses each month, he barely had any money in his pocket.

If he'd had tens of thousands of yuan in his pocket back then, Li Luo didn't know how much more confident he would have been.

Thinking this, Li Luo withdrew ten thousand yuan from his bank card, bought a stack of red envelopes from a roadside stall, and took out two of them, putting five thousand yuan into each.

After returning home, he waited for the three of them to get back from grocery shopping. During a moment when Xu Youyu had returned to her bedroom to wait for dinner and Ying Chanxi had gone to the restroom, Li Luo pulled Yan Zhusheng into the piano room and handed her the two red envelopes.

"What's this?" Yan Zhusheng looked confused for a moment.

"For you and Auntie Luo Fei," Li Luo said. "You're the original singer of 'Year Rings', and Auntie Luo Fei did the arrangement."

"I'll accept it on my auntie's behalf." Yan Zhusheng only took one red envelope, handing the other back to Li Luo and shaking her head. "I don't want money."

"I know you're not short on money, but this is just a normal distribution of collaborative profits. I already think I'm giving too little." Li Luo pressed the red envelope into Yan Zhusheng's palm. "Just take it. At worst, you can just buy me more snacks from time to time."

Yan Zhusheng couldn't win against him and accepted the red envelope with a frown, still looking a little unhappy.

"I see you don't usually interact with your dorm mates," Li Luo said. "You can occasionally buy some snacks and share them in the dorm."

"Oh," Yan Zhusheng responded, then said, "I'll teach you guitar tonight."

"Got it, Teacher Yan."

"What did you call me?"

"Teacher Yan, what's wrong?"

"I didn't hear you clearly."

"...You've been a bit too clever lately."

After dinner, Li Luo took Ying Zhicheng's ten-thousand-yuan guitar out of the piano room and sat on the living room sofa.

Yan Zhusheng stood in front of the coffee table, her face stern as she tried to maintain a teacher's authority.

Xu Youyu and Ying Chanxi sat to one side, getting a general idea of the situation.

"So, you're performing on stage for the Sports Day?" Xu Youyu was somewhat surprised. "You're not even in the rock club, are you?"

"I will be soon." Li Luo pulled an application form out of his school bag. "They said I can just let the supervising teacher know and get special permission to join."

"Doesn't the rock club have a single person who can play the guitar?" Ying Chanxi narrowed her eyes, seeming a little reluctant.

After hearing that Li Luo would be performing on stage, she felt less happy.

But the thought of Li Luo shining on stage also made her feel a strange sense of anticipation.

"A lot of the second-years have to participate in competitions recently." Li Luo looked exasperated. "There weren't many people to begin with, and with a few of them gone, they definitely can't form a full band."

"Well then, you two can start. We'll be the audience." Xu Youyu, half-lying on the sofa, gave Li Luo a light kick with her foot, already prepared to gather material.

"Brave Heart," Yan Zhusheng said. "I brought the sheet music."

"No need." Li Luo's fingers strummed lightly. "I've already memorized it."

Yan Zhusheng paused for a moment, then accepted this fact.

After all, this wasn't the first time Li Luo had done something like this.

In the living room at night, the plushies were lined up in a row on the windowsill.

An impassioned melody began to play.

But it was frequently interrupted by Yan Zhusheng.

"Here, it's too rushed. You can slow down a bit, and then here, pull it up instantly."

"Mm, the beginning is fine. There are no vocals in the interlude, so the rhythm needs to be richer."

"The two choruses have some differences, but what you're doing is good enough. Most people won't be able to tell."

After practicing for about an hour, Li Luo was exhausted, and thus Teacher Yan's lesson came to an end.

At first, Xu Youyu and Ying Chanxi had been watching with great interest, but Yan Zhusheng kept interrupting Li Luo's playing to demonstrate herself, making the whole process a bit tedious.

So, halfway through, Xu Youyu went back to her room to write.

Ying Chanxi also took out her math competition problems, placed them on the living room desk, and worked on them while watching the sofa.

Once the lesson was over, Ying Chanxi stood up and walked Yan Zhusheng downstairs, saying goodbye to her at the building entrance.

"I really like the gift you gave me." Ying Chanxi hugged her happily. "This is the first gift I've received from a girl since starting high school."

Yan Zhusheng blinked, a little dazed by Ying Chanxi's sudden hug.

Hmm... is this what having a friend feels like?

"I'm glad you like it."

"Is there anything you like, Zhusheng?" Ying Chanxi asked curiously with her hands behind her back.

Yan Zhusheng thought for a moment. "I like listening to music and running."

"I see, I get it." Ying Chanxi nodded, looking thoughtful. "Well, I'll see you off here. Be safe on your way back."

"Okay, goodbye."

"Bye-bye. And thank you for helping Li Luo practice today."

(End of this chapter)
